name: @payswap/onchain-adapters
description: Multi-chain adapter contracts for PaySwap 3.0 (Work Order P4-W3, lane R2-W3): EVM, Solana and UTXO chain-family adapters implementing the frozen adapter lifecycle (observe → prepare → simulate → authorize → broadcast → observe → finality → reconcile → evidence) behind injected provider transports. DETERMINISM LAW: transports are CONTRACTS (typed request/response shapes) and never perform I/O; the lifecycle is a pure state machine; everything runs offline. The environment/rail discriminator is STRUCTURAL (chain-identity registry + branded environment types + runtime re-derivation) — testnet/simulation can never be production financial execution. Adapters feed the onchain-security kernel through an INJECTED structural kernel port (the adapter never authorizes; the kernel owns authority) and map observations into the canonical settlement vocabulary behind a production-only gate (finality stays protocol-owned). Zero runtime dependencies; devDependencies are exactly the toolchain (typescript + vitest).
